note: REAL Alibaba trace jobs, small demo kitchen. Scheduler: rl_ppo. Decisions by the trained MaskablePPO policy.

trace_meta.scale_note: Real jobs, small demo kitchen (5 A100 nodes instead of ~290) so queues are visible. Scale is illustrative; the full-scale numbers are in the scoreboard. Takeaway = SIMULATED cloud fallback (8 GPUs, jobs waiting over 30 min are sent there at an assumed $3.37/GPU-hour, only if the predicted rental cost is under $30); it is not observed in the Alibaba trace.

cloud.price_basis: No Alibaba GPU model has an exact price in the pricing data; tiers are anchored to the cheapest hourly offer of a related model. Cloud capacity, overflow trigger and price multiplier are configurable scenario assumptions; no Alibaba cloud assignment is observed.

trace_meta.thermal: proxy (measured H100 profile), not measured on these GPUs
trace_meta.hint: runtime hint model v3 (job-history + submit-burst features; new orders have no history, so the pool median is used)
